notes.title: Hiatus is over.
notes.notes:
For personal and financial reasons, the game is on hiatus since February. It is being continued. Unity has been updated to 2019.1.5f1, and a new ambient background nature recording is being edited. An options menu is being worked on, and the main menu will continue to be improved.

There is still a very long way to go, but will appreciate any support as this becomes more of an actual video game.

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
The first update is now live. The game will now be updated more frequently, multiple times a month. Below is the changelist.

[u]Patch Notes[/u]

Many optimizations for a more stable framerate
Headlamp light range 10 feet further
Widened headlamp beam
Increased walk speed
Added many business interiors to Dennett Main Street
Revamped Dennett High School interior and added second floor classrooms
Added more hills and landscapes
Modeled new trees and stumps
Modeled new door types
Lessened weight of doors, easier to push
New 3d models
Various details
